rounds.report:
Representation level: L1 (proxy). CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline (not a Blender-equivalent protocol).

Observed (24 reference samples): one continuous overhead (top-down) tracking shot, no cuts, letterboxed 2.40:1. 0-1.1 s: two blonde figures tumble on a stairwell (stairs run along image vertical, window at top-left, green right wall). 1.1-5.3 s: camera travels image-right over a cutaway divider (fluorescent tubes, dark near-camera beam and railing rods pass), revealing a bedroom with a white turntable, wooden floor and a bed (orange/green striped blanket, cream sheet, green duvet). The olive-sweater figure (A) pursues the pale cream-clothed figure (V) across the floor. 5.9-9.6 s: V falls back onto the bed end and lies supine, head to image-right; A kneels astride her, leaning over with hands on her chest; the camera descends slightly. 9.6-12.3 s: camera rises and tilts toward the back wall, revealing the toy shelf, a plate and a bright lamp at image-right.

Geometry: boxes/spheres/cylinders for stairs, walls, window, tubes, turntable, bed layers, shelf, lamp, back wall. Two articulated figures (pelvis root, spine, neck/head/hair, shoulders, elbows, hips, knees) posed by keyframes at sample times and linearly interpolated.
Camera: perspective 36 deg vertical FOV, up vector = -Z, Hermite-spline track through per-sample positions estimated from object image positions; tilt toward the back wall only in the last ~2.6 s.
Timing: absolute-time sampling at the metadata timeline (295 frames, 23.976 fps).

Inference / uncertainty: the stair-phase tumble, exact subject poses between samples, stair direction and heights, and the possibility of a third person in the early stair frames (treated as two subjects) are inferred. Camera roll visible in some transit frames is not modelled.

Render feedback: none yet (initial round).
